targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (intersection_id) intersection_id, signal_latency, power_voltage, error_count FROM telemetry ORDER BY intersection_id, timestamp DESC) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN signal_latency <= 2 AND power_voltage >= 220 AND error_count < 5 THEN 1 WHEN signal_latency <= 3 AND power_voltage >= 210 AND error_count < 10 THEN 0.7 ELSE 0.3 END)) AS health FROM latest;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS intersections FROM intersections;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (intersection_id) intersection_id, signal_latency, power_voltage, error_count FROM telemetry ORDER BY intersection_id, timestamp DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signal_latency > 3 OR power_voltage < 210 OR error_count >= 10) AS high_risk FROM latest;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS telemetry_24h FROM telemetry WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

SELECT timestamp AS time, intersection_id AS metric, traffic_volume FROM telemetry WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes' AND ('${intersection}' = 'All' OR intersection_id = '${intersection}') ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT timestamp AS time, intersection_id AS metric, signal_latency FROM telemetry WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes' AND ('${intersection}' = 'All' OR intersection_id = '${intersection}') ORDER BY timestamp;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.intersection_id) t.* FROM telemetry t ORDER BY t.intersection_id, t.timestamp DESC) SELECT i.name, i.id, i.latitude, i.longitude, l.timestamp, l.traffic_volume, l.signal_latency, l.power_voltage, l.error_count, CASE WHEN l.signal_latency > 3 OR l.power_voltage < 210 OR l.error_count >= 10 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN l.signal_latency > 2 OR l.power_voltage < 220 OR l.error_count >= 5 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS risk FROM intersections i JOIN latest l ON l.intersection_id = i.id ORDER BY i.id;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.intersection_id) t.* FROM telemetry t ORDER BY t.intersection_id, t.timestamp DESC) SELECT i.name AS intersection, l.timestamp, l.traffic_volume, l.signal_latency, l.power_voltage, l.error_count, CASE WHEN l.signal_latency > 3 OR l.power_voltage < 210 OR l.error_count >= 10 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN l.signal_latency > 2 OR l.power_voltage < 220 OR l.error_count >= 5 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS risk FROM intersections i JOIN latest l ON l.intersection_id = i.id WHERE ('${intersection}' = 'All' OR i.id = '${intersection}') ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.signal_latency > 3 OR l.power_voltage < 210 OR l.error_count >= 10 THEN 1 WHEN l.signal_latency > 2 OR l.power_voltage < 220 OR l.error_count >= 5 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, l.timestamp DESC;

SELECT timestamp AS time, intersection_id AS metric, power_voltage FROM telemetry WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes' AND ('${intersection}' = 'All' OR intersection_id = '${intersection}') ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT timestamp AS time, intersection_id AS metric, error_count FROM telemetry WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes' AND ('${intersection}' = 'All' OR intersection_id = '${intersection}') ORDER BY timestamp;

**Problem → Reason → Solution**

The telemetry pipeline detects abnormal intersection behaviour using the Phase 1 rules. AI analysis is available through the CITYOS AI service on port `8010` and is backed by Ollama.

**Current model**
`llama3.2:3b`

**Next workflow**
1. Detect anomaly
2. Send telemetry to AI
3. Generate likely cause
4. Recommend action
5. Track outcome
